name: Promo Badge Pop

behavior.description: Pop the selected badge label or discount value into view with a small rotational overshoot and one damped correction.
behavior.targetSelection: badge and discount are alternatives. Choose one present hook name in the selected component and animate matching elements of that name only; do not require both or implicitly animate their component container.
behavior.keyframeTiming: at is seconds from start; easing on a keyframe applies to the following interval.

adaptation: Rotation is an additive degree offset and scale multiplies the selected hook's authored base scale; the enclosing sticker, stamp or corner pose remains unchanged. x/y use design pixels at 1080x1920 scaled with the frame; opacity is absolute. Use a layout-preserving motion layer for inline labels, keeping decorative badge clip-path and parent shapes intact. Initialize at assigned start, derive poses from local time, and hold the final state without looping.
